products.name: Cisco Webex AI
products.note: Meeting intelligence; real-time translation; noise removal; enterprise security

profile_text.body:
Cisco is a publicly traded worldwide technology company (NASDAQ: CSCO, CIK 0000858877) that describes itself as a leader in AI infrastructure, secure networking, and software solutions. Its site presents a broad portfolio spanning AI-optimized networking, purpose-built programmable silicon for AI workloads, data center modernization, and security embedded across network layers. The company also highlights Cisco IQ, described as a unified AI-powered experience delivering real-time insights, troubleshooting, automation, and agent-driven guidance to support professional services.

On the AI product side, Cisco offers Cisco Webex AI, tracked under the notes, knowledge, and meetings category, with capabilities including meeting intelligence, real-time translation, noise removal, and enterprise security. The company's site additionally describes autonomous network operations driven by policy-bound agents that execute complex workflows, positioned as a step beyond traditional visibility tools. The McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team is cited on Cisco's site as a customer using Cisco networking and security for AI workloads processing race data across 24 races worldwide.

No litigation or MCP server records are held for Cisco at this time.
